definitions.explanation: The short form of {参議院|さんぎいん}, the upper house of Japan's Diet, used in news headlines and reports. Its members serve six-year terms, and half the seats are elected every three years.

examples.japanese: {参院|さんいん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{可決|かけつ}→可決：00148_kaketsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The bill was passed in the upper house.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧、{参院選|さんいんせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The House of Councillors election will be held next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{衆院|しゅういん}→衆院：32455_shuuin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通過|つうか}した→通過する：22435_tsuukasuru⟧⟦{予算案|よさんあん}→予算案：09761_yosanan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{参院|さんいん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{審議|しんぎ}→審議：19112_shingi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移|うつ}った→移る：01232_utsuru⟧。
examples.english: The budget bill that passed the lower house moved on to deliberation in the upper house.

notes:
{参院|さんいん} and ⟦{衆院|しゅういん}→衆院：32455_shuuin⟧ are the news-register short forms of ⟦{参議院|さんぎいん}→参議院：15158_sangiin⟧ and ⟦{衆議院|しゅうぎいん}→衆議院：14153_shuugiin⟧; in speech and formal writing the full names are usual.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {参院選|さんいんせん}: House of Councillors election
- {参院|さんいん}⟦{議員|ぎいん}→議員：02660_giin⟧: member of the House of Councillors
- {参院|さんいん}{本会議|ほんかいぎ}: plenary session of the upper house

USAGE:
The lower house, ⟦{衆院|しゅういん}→衆院：32455_shuuin⟧, can be dissolved and has the stronger say on budgets and the choice of prime minister; the upper house cannot be dissolved.
